query:
SELECT 
  r.id as receivable_id,
  r.saleId,
  r.totalAmount as receivable_total,
  r.receivedAmount,
  (CAST(r.totalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2)) - CAST(r.receivedAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as receivable_pending,
  s.finalAmount as sale_final,
  r.status
FROM receivables r
LEFT JOIN sales s ON r.saleId = s.id
WHERE r.customerId = 22
  AND r.status IN ('PENDENTE', 'PARCIAL', 'VENCIDO')
ORDER BY r.id;
